status: Retained measurement-boundary repair with focused regressions, full release unit validation, strict Clippy/docs, and matched valid-input cost evidence. Broader consumer integration remains open.
scope: Guard exact polygon measurements against source-construction failure, exhausted budgets, and preview context; cache completed STRICT successes only; remove the report-chord area fallback.
cache_contract: One completed STRICT area and bounds value per immutable region, shared by polygon clones. Unavailable results are retryable; concurrent cold queries may duplicate work. Warm values are denied after operation budget exhaustion. No new cache capacity or whole-operation time/memory bound is asserted.

tests.note: Complete unit suite; this preceded the two dependency-only Gerber ok_or lint edits.

Component extraction/projection caches, source-native circles, clearance consumers, conservative spatial indices, and typed readiness propagation are separate follow-up work.
